name: Adeia Inc.
blurb: Adeia Inc. is a media and semiconductor intellectual property licensing platform company incorporated in 1990 and headquartered in the United States. The company owns and licenses large patent portfolios to multichannel video programming distributors — including cable, satellite, and telecom TV providers — as well as streaming services and semiconductor manufacturers globally. With approximately 150 employees, Adeia operates a capital-light, royalty-driven model, generating revenue by licensing its IP across North America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and other international markets. The company was spun out of Xperi Inc. in 2022 and trades under the ticker ADEA on the Nasdaq.
recent: Adeia reported earnings on May 4, 2026, with trailing-twelve-month revenue of $460.5M (+21.1% year-over-year), net income of $122M (+61.6%), and EPS of $1.09 (+65.1%), reflecting strong licensing deal momentum. The stock closed at $31.72 on May 13, 2026 — near its 52-week high of $34.34 — with a market cap of approximately $3.5B, up sharply from a 52-week low of $11.61. An upcoming ex-dividend date of May 26, 2026 ($0.20/share) is also on the near-term calendar.
